errors.not_implemented: The hub declares {operation} in the contract but does not implement it yet.
errors.connection: Could not reach the hub. Check the connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.setup_unknown: Could not ask this hub whether it still needs first-run setup. Sign in, or reload the page.

setup.title: Create the owner account
setup.intro: This hub has no account yet. Create the owner here, with the setup token the hub wrote when it started.
setup.where_title: Where to find the setup token
setup.where_body: The hub printed it once in its log when it started, and wrote it to setup-token.txt inside the data directory. On the reference stack:
setup.where_local: Running the hub outside Docker: the file is in your DATA_DIR (./data/setup-token.txt by default). A new token is generated on every restart until this account exists.
setup.token_hint: Paste it exactly; it is compared as a whole and never stored in the browser.
setup.username_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore — 2 to 40 characters.
setup.workspace_hint: The name of the first workspace; "Default" when left empty.
setup.password_hint: {min} characters or more. It is never shown, logged or stored anywhere but as a hash.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.submit: Create the account and sign in
setup.unattended: An unattended install can still set HUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD before the first boot; the hub then creates the owner itself and this screen never appears.

shell.segment_later: {name} arrives with its module in a later phase.

pane.resize: Resize the side pane (arrow keys resize, Home collapses, End expands)

sessions.empty: No sessions in this workspace yet. Start one with New chat.
sessions.reorder: Reorder {title} (Space to pick up, arrows to move)
sessions.confirm_delete_body: Its messages go with it, and there is no undo.
sessions.retitle_hint: Let the hub name this chat again, from its own first turn.

new_chat.pick_agent: Pick the agent this chat talks to. The list is the hub's registry.
new_chat.no_agents: No agent is enabled on this hub. Install or enable one in Agent Manager.
new_chat.lede: Pick an installed agent from the chips, choose a working folder if you like, then type.
new_chat.none_installed: No agent is installed on this hub yet. Hermes ships with it; if it reads "not installed", check that it is running, or install one from the catalog in

chat.pick_one: Pick a session from the list, or start a new chat.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say something below.
chat.resynced: Reconnected; the transcript was reloaded from the hub.
chat.no_provider: No model provider is configured for this workspace, so the agent has nothing to run on.
chat.no_key: The provider rejected the stored key, so the agent could not reach it.
chat.pick_one_body: Every chat keeps its own agent, its folder and its history.
chat.fork_explains: Another agent copies this conversation into a new chat with it and leaves this one as it is. The model selector below changes only this chat.
chat.speak_later: Speech arrives in a later phase.

composer.label: Message composer
composer.placeholder: Message the agent… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.busy_hint: A run is active; your next message is queued behind it.
composer.drop_hint: Or drop files straight onto the composer.
composer.approval_unsupported: This agent declares no approval mode.
composer.dictate_unavailable: Dictation arrives with a speech provider (models.transcribe is still 501).

approval_hint.ask: Asks before a command or a write outside the working folder.
approval_hint.always: Asks before everything, reads included — slowest, safest.
approval_hint.auto_safe: Runs what it judges safe, asks about the rest.
approval_hint.auto_all: Runs everything without asking; nothing to object to.
approval_hint.off: No gate at all: commands, files and network without permission.

approval.answer_hint: Type your answer… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

agents.limited: This agent runs through the process harness and is limited.
agents.auto_update_hint: Takes a new version as soon as it ships, without asking.

settings.global_note: This screen is hub-wide, outside the current workspace.
settings.management_hint: Configured once: whole pages, not tabs.

about.agent_manager: Install, update and configure each agent
about.device_connections: Pair a phone and trusted devices

glass.label: Glass intensity
glass.hint: Translucency and blur of the floating chrome only; content stays solid.

display.local_only: Saved on this device only; the hub could not store the preference.

reasoning.label: Show the agent's reasoning
reasoning.hint: A "thought for …" line above the reply, with the text behind a disclosure.

theme.intro: Theme and background of this device. The footer chip changes the same preference.
theme.reduced_note: If your system asks for reduced transparency or motion, the app honours it automatically.

devices.pair_intro: Pair a phone: scan the QR with the Majlis app, or type the code. The code expires in five minutes.
devices.pairing_expired: The pairing expired. Start a new one.

placeholder.later: {name} arrives with its module in phase {phase}. Nothing is hidden here.

providers.hint: The providers you added. A key is typed once here; every agent uses it.
providers.empty: No provider of this kind is configured.
providers.none: No providers yet. Add the first one and its models arrive with it.

provider.key_stored: [stored] — paste a new key to replace it
provider.label: Name
provider.confirm_remove_body: Its key and its model list go with it, and there is no undo.

defaults.hint: One chat model and one coding model. Every agent inherits them unless it is pinned to something else.
defaults.no_models: No models yet. Add a provider key and the hub fetches its model list.
defaults.inheriting_hint: What each agent will use when a chat does not name a model.

ensembles.hint: Ensembles are created over the API for now; this tab lands with the rooms screens.

test.http_error: The provider answered with an error.

panel.no_models: No models yet. Refresh the model list first.
panel.visibility_all_hint: Including whatever the provider adds later.
panel.visibility_include_hint: Pick them in the table below.
panel.caption: Models of {provider}

add.fetch_failed: The provider did not return a model list.
add.fetch_empty: The provider answered, but listed no models.
add.loopback: This address is loopback, and the hub runs in a container — it would reach the container itself, not your machine. Try {url}, and on a Linux host add extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"] to the stack.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.hint: What the agent runtime received from this workspace.

runtime_writable.ok: The hub manages the agent runtime.
runtime_writable.missing: No agent runtime this hub can configure.

provider_keys.ok: Provider keys are in the runtime's environment.
provider_keys.missing: A provider key has not reached the runtime.

provider_verified.ok: Every provider answered its last check.
provider_verified.missing: A provider refused its last check — open it and fix the key.

model_selected.ok: A chat model is selected for the runtime.
model_selected.missing: No chat model is selected — choose one under Defaults.

gateway_reloaded.ok: The runtime restarted after the last change.
gateway_reloaded.missing: The runtime has not restarted since the last change.

working_dir.label: Working folder
working_dir.hint: Where this chat works on disk.
working_dir.automatic_note: the hub names it after the session
working_dir.locked: The folder is fixed once the chat has run.

combobox.error: The list could not be fetched.

queue.title: Message queue
queue.steer_hint: Stop the live turn and take this instead, in the same context.

tasks.no_projects_body: Tasks live inside a project. Create one to start.
tasks.intake_hint: A task arrives here, is specified, and then joins the queue.

schedules.new_hint: Saved, with its next run computed; running on its own arrives with the worker.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.prompt: What should the agent be asked?
schedules.cron_hint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday.
schedules.run_unavailable: The hub does not start runs yet; a schedule is saved and its next time computed.

notify.none_body: What happens in the hub appears here: a reply that finished, or an approval waiting for you.
notify.quiet_hint: A window in which no notification is pushed to your devices.
notify.push_note: Quiet hours are about device notifications, not the inbox — what is written at night is still here in the morning. Device notifications are not built yet.
